reference_behaviors: Pinned DynamicInfo returns last_run_time as creation_time and creation_time as last_run_time.
COM GUID components are hexadecimal integers without leading zero padding.
TimeMode has string enum values; encoded integer modes give no Time trigger description.
Exec actions with an empty command or empty arguments return no action; context is preserved.
Email properties are consumed but the pinned decoder does not return an Email action object.
Idle and Registration triggers are labeled Logon by the fixed decoder.
limitations: Positive real evidence covers Windows 10 build 15063 and Windows 7 build 7601 x64 only. Intel x86 has decoder coverage, not positive real-image acceptance. ARM64 is rejected.
Binary values are bounded to 1 MiB by the shared registry reader. At most 4096 actions/triggers/queries per value and MAX_OBJECTS output rows; limits preserve partial diagnostics.
Truncated recognized triggers retain earlier decoded triggers and principal/display fields and report partial. This deliberately does not imitate unbounded reads or Python parser exceptions.
Output times have whole-second precision following the fixed TaskCache reference decoder.
Loaded hive/process-list diagnostics are retained; no claim that a matching row set proves complete image coverage.
Nonempty Event query lists, MessageBox/Email consumption, SID decoding and malformed binary boundaries have synthetic tests. More real examples and arbitrary Unicode query repr remain unverified.
Canonical scheduled-task timeline integration and complete option/failure contracts are outstanding. Legacy seven-column task output and timeline source remain separate.
